name: Momentum Network - The Campaign At Scale
description: The network the campaign is working toward: every Harvard school represented, clusters overlapping, each supporter wired to several neighbours rather than hung off a school junction. This is the density the design direction was composed for, and the state that answers its central note — the exploration read as a constellation of stars because a point with one thread to a hub is a star on a string, not a node. The canvas is sized to the supporter count, so this same picture reads as densely with nineteen people as with two hundred.
